data.name: Emma: Tactical Upgrade NIKKE Battle Announcer
data.desc:
With a team, there's usually 3 roles you can take on. Attacker, defender, or supporter. Out of those 3, being a supporter doesn't have a straightforward way to grow further. An attacker can deal more damage, attack faster/more frequently, or find an alternate source of damage. A defender can strengthen defenses, provide counter attacks, or work in tandem with the attacker. A supporter can focus on other objectives for the team or provide additional firepower, but that seems to be it on the surface. However, with a tactical upgrade, Emma can now disperse special liquids in her outfit for specific situations. One of these liquids can act as a disruptor for communication devices and doubles as they relay information back to Emma. Certainly, an underrated feature for a support role.

-----
When an enemy is killed (10 sec cooldown):
"Well then, shall we face it together?"
"I'll make sure they don't move an inch."
"Alright everyone, let's relax and get started."
"That was great. Hehe."
"It's done."
"Nothing to worry about."
"Liquid solution at the ready."
"Here you go! A little therapy for everyone."
"C'mon, everyone, let's all attack together!"
"If you need cover fire during battle, leave it to me."
"Enemy spotted. Should we engage?"
"If you need anything, just let me know, okay?"

-----
When the player takes damage (15 sec cooldown):
"Hang on just a sec."
"Sorry, this is taking a while, isn't it?"
"I just need a short break to reload."
"Ahh!"
"Oh my!"
"Eek!"

-----
When a heist ends in success:
"You did great, Commander. Did you like the new scent?"
"You seem a bit worn out, Commander. Here, lay your head on my lap. I've been studying a new kind of therapy."
"Anytime you want to relax, you can always come to me."
"Vesti, Eunhwa, and you are all precious to me, Commander. But with you, it feels a little more special somehow."

-----
When a heist ends in failure:
"I'm sorry, Commander... I might have overdone it..."

-----

# Known bugs:
- Alesso heist is stuck at 99% on loading screen.
	- Reason: You don't have BeardLib installed or it's outdated. This happens because the marked doors highlights requires beardlib in order to work.
- Marking cameras disables their highlights.
	- Reason: Unlike enemies and civilians, cameras doesn't have a function to turn low quality when seen from afar, which is what Highlighter requires for working with markable stuff.
- Dragon Heist and Crude Awakening crowbars won't get highlighted unless you get near one.
	- Reason: The game highlights it automatically when you get close to it.
- Prison Nightmare hidden pumpkin will also highlight the trophy in your safehouse.
	- Reason: The files are the same.
- ATMs will stay highlighted even after they're open.
	- Reason: The files are the same.
- Enter The Gungeon statues will also highlight the trophies in your safehouse.
	- Reason: The files are the same.
- The vial centrifuges are not getting highlighted from the start of the heist
	- It only gets highlighted after you trigger the blood samples validation objective and after you get near it for the first time.
- Buluc's Mansion churro will also highlight the churro asset in Breakfast In Tijuana.
	- Reason: The files are the same.
- The White House secret will have your murky uniforms highlighted when you get out of the elevator.
	- Reason: The files are the same.
- The important NPC highlights also adds contour to some useless civilians in a few other heists.
	- Reason: The files are the same.
- The infected patient in No Mercy has only his tattoo highlighted.
	- Reason: Highlighting the patient's whole body would affect all 3 patients. Highlighting only the tattoo points which one is the correct patient.
- Goat Simulator planks won't have the white color.
	- Reason: Only way I've found to make the highlight work with those planks.
- 8th anniversary statue for Rats will only highlight it's base.
	- Reason: Highlighting the whole object would cause texture glitches and keep it unhighlighted.
- A mega sangres mask gift box is not getting highlighted on San Martín Bank.
	- Reason: It spawns inside a white van on the street and will only get highlighted once you open it.
- Some highlights suddenly stops working with items behind walls or at a far distance.
	- Reason: The game either reduces the item resolution or simply despawns it until you're close enough or if it's not obstructed. Despawned items cannot be highlighted.

# FAQ
**Q: Is this mod still getting updated?**
A: Yes. This mod will get updated whenever a new item worth of being highlighted is released. I accept feedback and ideas for new highlights too.

**Q: Does it trigger the cheater tag on me or can I get banned by using it?**
A: No. Comments related to this will be ignored and deleted.

**Q: Can you highlight:**
- safes
- diamond heist saphires display cases
- birth of sky money bundles
- circuit boxes
- goats

A: No. Those items can't get highlighted with the methods I use and each has their own reasons so don't bother asking. Comments related to this will be ignored and deleted.

**Q: Where should I install it?**
A: Read the install instructions tab. Comments related to this will be ignored and deleted.

**Q: Can you make a function to toggle highlights on and off?**
A: No. Comments related to this will be ignored and deleted.

**Q: Can anyone see the highlights?**
A: No. This mod is client sided and will work regardless if you're the host or if you join someone who doesn't have it installed. Comments related to this will be ignored and deleted.

**Q: The mod doesn't work.**
A: The mod works just fine. Comments related to this will be ignored and deleted.
If it doesn't work for you then:
- You installed in the wrong folder.
- You extracted the folders from the .zip file into one folder.
- You didn't read the install instructions tab.

data.name: Gilza - Weapon and skill rebalance
data.desc:
:::

### Originally inspired by [IREnFIST](https://modworkshop.net/mod/28585) 

:::

Payday 2 is one of my favorite games, despite how poorly balanced it is. I have accumulated over 6k hours at this point, and this mod in particular i have started working on all the way back at ~3k hour mark.

This ~~small~~ rebalance is what i have come up with, to make a game that i already enjoy, even more enjoyable. At least for me.


-----

:::
### Welcome to Gilza
:::

:::
A Payday 2 weapons/skills/perks rebalance/overhaul. 
(FYI - "Gilza" is a Russian word for "Bullet casing")
:::

#### What is this mod about?

As the title suggests - it changes most skills, perks and all weapons of Payday 2. All changes made by this mod are only available to the player who has it installed, without affecting gameplay for other players. It works in online lobbies regardless of if you are client or host.

#### How difficult is this mod?
This rebalance is {#eb4034}(not trying) to make the game easy. It was made by me - for me, and i consider myself a pretty decent FPS player. If you think of yourself as an average/casual player, you may find some (mostly weapon) tweaks too difficult for you.

#### Main goals of this mod:
* Make **__ALL__** weapons equally viable across all difficulties - this includes nerfing over-performing weapons.
* Update damage altering skills to make players rely on damage buffs less often.
* Provide players with more fun skill/perk combinations for improved build variety.
* Make every skill and perk useful/less situational.

-----


:::
### {#00CCC1}(Rebalance info summary)
:::

Detailed information on [skill](https://github.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/blob/main/Gilza%20txts/General_and_Skills.md), [perk](https://github.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/blob/main/Gilza%20txts/Perks.md) and [weapon](https://github.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/blob/main/Gilza%20txts/Weapons.md) changes can be found on pages dedicated to them. (Perk page includes recommended builds)  
On this page you may find a short summary for some of the rebalance changes of this mod.


#### Stealth
99% of the rebalance changes of this mod are focused on loud gameplay, and the perk page does not provide any examples for stealth builds. If you are planning on playing in stealth, there are only a few things to note, compared to vanilla:
!!!
* Basic "Stockholm Syndrome"'s civilian intimidation bonus was moved to tier 2 skill "Confident" in the same tree, making it 1 point more expensive
* Tier 1 and 2 skills in Shinobi sub tree of Ghost were shuffled around a little. Keep these changes in mind if your Shinobi sub-tree is usually not maxed out
* Consider running new "Parkour" aced skill on some maps, and maybe even a doctor bag along with it.
* "Burglar" perk deck's stealth bonuses were buffed from 10-20% to 25%
* "Hacker"s PECM cooldown was increased from 100 to 150 seconds (Hacker is still better than Burglar, since it can help clear up mistakes, but the choice is a little bit less one sided now)
!!!


#### Enemy changes
All enemies now have same amount of health on all difficulties, with values being similar to vanilla Death Wish difficulty.  
Headshot multipliers are now set to 2x for most enemies, with exceptions for some special enemies.

#### Melee rework
Melee weapons now deal % damage - if your melee has 35 damage, it will deal 35% of enemy's total health in one hit. Some enemies take reduced damage, to avoid melee weapons one-shot'ing everything.

#### Skills/Perks
Detailed skills info page can be found [here](https://github.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/blob/main/Gilza%20txts/General_and_Skills.md).
Detailed perks info page can be found [here](https://github.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/blob/main/Gilza%20txts/Perks.md). This page includes at least 1 recommended build for every perk deck for loud gameplay, in case you don't want to go through all the changes Gilza makes in one go.

__Default upgrades/changes__ 
- By default, regardless of equipped skills, perks and weapons, all weapon swap speeds are sped up by 50%. This is done to incentivize players to use both of their weapons proactively more often, as Gilza's ammo economy is extremely harsh if played otherwise.
- Ammo pick up rates for standard and throwable weapons now scale with equipped armor (suit/ictv etc), with bigger armors providing more ammo per pickup. This should help low movement armors with ammo pickups.
- While hosting a lobby (either online or offline) Team AI bots will now drop less ammo boxes from their kills. Every kill they get now has a 25% chance to drop ammo whenever you have 3 bots, 50% at 2 bots, and 75% at 1 bot. This only affects Team AI, and does not affect converts and sentries. This should make ammo accessibility in offline games feel close to online games, so that the disparity between the 2 would not be as drastic.

__Global - damage resistance__ 
All damage resistance upgrades are now additive instead of multiplicative. For more info you can go to the skills info page, under general section.

__Skills__
Extent of skill changes is too vast to sum up, so you should check the "Skills Legend" picture bellow, which summarizes skill rework information - if a skill was updated or not, and how significantly. Check out whatever you think might be interesting on the skills info page :)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/refs/heads/main/Gilza_pics/Skill_Images/Skills%20legend.jpg)

__Perks__
Most perks received minor updates to improve their design (mostly for DS difficulty), with only 3 perks gaining "major" reworks. Don't forget to go over general (or "neutral") perk deck cards on the perk page, since they apply to all perks, and by extension to all builds.  
Additionally, 3 new custom perks were added - "Brawler", "Speed Junkie" and "Guardian".

#### Weapon Changes

Detailed weapon info page can be found [here](https://github.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/blob/main/Gilza%20txts/Weapons.md).

__Damage and ammo:__
All guns are now categorized under a "damage class" - all weapons have a strict starting damage value, which are all based around specific breakpoints (aka amount of bullets to kill certain enemy types). This makes both balancing and gun building easier to manage.  
Ammo pick up is now dependent only on weapon damage class, and it is __much much__ worse (roughly 65% of what you would have in vanilla). You **HAVE** to use both of your weapons, and *even then* you can still run out, especially on lengthy heists. Using melee and throwable weapons is somewhat mandatory, to avoid running out of ammo quickly.

For example, Galil ("Gecko 7.62" in game) deals 67 damage in vanilla. If you take into account a maxed out perk deck, you will deal ~70.3 damage on a bodyshot and ~263.8 on a headshot with it in vanilla (based on Death wish difficulty health/headshot multipliers), which means this weapon will kill a light swat in 2 headshots and a heavy swat in 4 headshots, while having an average ammo pick up of ~10.04 (with any maxed out perk deck).
In Gilza a similar damage class exists - 125. With it, you will also kill a light swat in 2 headshots and a heavy swat in 4 headshots, but this damage class has ~6.44 ammo pick up on average, forcing you to be more accurate with it and to use your other weapons.

__Recoil:__
Most guns have more recoil.
Recoil camera compensation is almost completely removed.
Weapon recoil now depends on your base stability: weapons with low base stability will have extremely high recoil, and vice versa.

__Handling:__
Weapon accuracy and stability are no longer affected if you: crouch, jump, walk or sprint. However, both accuracy and stability have a penalty if you are firing from the hip. Aiming down sights removes this penalty.
All weapons have an accuracy penalty if used in full-auto and burst fire modes. If you use the select fire keybind to switch weapon to single-fire mode, you weapon will gain it's full accuracy.

__Bipods:__
Implemented "Battlefield 5 style" bipod mounting system where the bipod is automatically placed when player is close enough to a valid surface. To reduce frustrations this deployment method prevents certain limitations that bipods normally have in vanilla, like camera limits, ability to interact with items, and moving.

Bipods video preview:
!!!
![](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y8_BJ50YIng)
!!!

{#eb4034}(__**IMPORTANT**__): for your first try of the mod make a backup of your save files.  
If you dislike the mod and choose to remove it, it will __not__ have any issues, and it will __not__ corrupt your save files, BUT you might lose some weapons from your inventory, due to updates in their attachment data.
Also your perks can get reset. Perk reset DOES NOT remove how many perk points you have (points you use to unlock perks), but it might remove your progression, and leave you with all perks at 0/9, forcing you to go through all of them while holding the + button. (use R (default keybind) while on the perks screen to max out a perk quickly).

{#eb4034}(__**EVEN MORE IMPORTANT**__): if you are going to give Gilza a try, check all mods that Gilza requires to function, under "Dependencies and Instructions". All mods that are tagged as "optional" are sorted in order of importance, from highest at the top to lowest at the bottom. I recommend getting everything before (but preferably also including) FrenchyAu's weapon attachment packs.


{#eb4034}(__**Last thing**__): don't immediately try to play this mod on whatever difficulty you usually prefer, maybe try to play it on a difficulty bellow that for a game or two, as some aspects of Gilza could be a bit too difficult initially.

P.S Gambler rework is the most fun one in my opinion :D

# Custom Weapons Support

This mod will automatically search for custom weapons and convert their damage stats to work with Gilza's health changes. Beware: some custom weapons may have attachments that change damage/ammo pick up/total max ammo, or other stats in such a way that it will not match Gilza's values well, making them either too good, or bad. I can't do anything about that, other than __manually__ adding support for __every gun individually__, and that will take time. You may find a list of weapons that are currently supported on the [weapon info page.](https://github.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/blob/main/Gilza%20txts/Weapons.md#custom-weapons-support)

Custom "special" category weapons are not supported by the automatic stat adjustment system, but may be added later individually, check the currently supported list to see if they are already supported.

# Additional QOL features

* VanillaHud+'s buff list is supported for all major skill updates that Gilza makes, allowing for easy tracking of new skills' cooldowns and such.
* While charging your melee weapons new melee UI will appear showing your charge amount and damage in %. This can be tweaked or disabled in Gilza's mod options.
* You can set up a keybind in Gilza's mod options for a "melee only" toggle mode. While in this mode the game automatically charges melee weapons for you, and makes primary attack button the trigger for melee swings. You can cancel this mode by using the same keybind or melee attack button. Additional options, like position of this mode's HUD indicator, it's size and location are also accessible in Gilza's mod options.
* You can disable camera tilt while charging melee weapons to reduce motion sickness if you extensively use melee (like with the new Brawler perk deck). This can be tweaked or disabled in Gilza's mod options.
* You can reset your perk progression to re-acquire perk decks, allowing you to try new custom perk decks without grinding XP to unlock them. This option does not reset amount of perk points you have already earned.
* Vehicle FOV was changed from base 75 to 90 - you can change it in mod options in game.
* While purchasing weapons on the blackmarket, they can now be sorted by their damage classes, either in ascending or descending order. This option can be disabled.
* You can spoof Gilza's custom perks, to avoid getting auto kicked in higher difficulty public lobbies, since some players are purists and can not comprehend any rebalance mods. This option can be disabled in Gilza's mod options.

# Known issue:
You can crash when entering a heist, while using Jackal SMG or one of the Chimano pistols, with certain attachment combos, or while using the Kang arms model 54 pistol. This can only happen with weapons that you have modified/purchased before installing Gilza, due to updates in their attachments data. Simply re-purchase them if you run into this issue.

# Included mods
* [Auto Fire Sound Fix](https://modworkshop.net/mod/20403) - needed for rate of fire adjustments for some weapons, and for some new skills. Thanks to [Offyerrocker](https://modworkshop.net/user/offyerrocker) for allowing this.
* Various WeaponLib crashes and bugs (like shotgun damage) are fixed by Gilza.
* [Akron HC set sound fix](https://modworkshop.net/mod/41269) - Another mod of mine that fixes sounds for this weapon if you have Auto Fire Sound Fix, and since Gilza comes with AFSF it only makes sense to add this too. 


# Compatibility
Gilza can detect *some* mods that it may conflict with on it's own, and will give you a warning pop up after loading into the main menu. Otherwise:
* Payday 2 VR is __not__ supported.
* Custom perks are __not__ supported as they will conflict with existing neutral perk card changes.
* Any other skill/perk/weapon changing mods will either break the balance, won't work correctly or straight up crash your game, so avoid those.
* Custom weapons are supported, but aren't perfect unless weapon was manually altered by me to work with Gilza's stats. For list of those go to the [weapon](https://github.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/blob/main/Gilza%20txts/Weapons.md) page.

# Supported languages (depends on your SuperBLT's language):
- English
- Russian - а именно описания всех навыков, перков, оружий, элементы HUD'а и меню. Некоторые элементы могут быть на английском - если найдете что-нибудь не переведенное, пишите в комменты.

Enjoy figuring out your new META and please provide feedback if something feels way too powerful or underwhelming.
Good luck and have fun! :D

data.name: PiP Scopes v1.3
data.desc:
**Thanks to Diesel 3.0/64bit update, the previsouly VR-exclusive feature of PiP (Picture-in-Picture) scopes can now be ported into the flatscreen game without much hassle.**

---

### What the mod does:
 - Makes every "scope" in the game Picture-in-Picture - drawing a separately rendered zoomed image inside the scope
 - Lowers the standard camera-FOV-zoom when entering ADS to the default vanilla minimal (same as angled sights, etc)
 - Removes the Y-axis of the so-called "stance_mod" for "Sniper Scopes" - when removing the camera-FOV-zoom, it is noticeable that the gun shifts dramatically backwards with those, so that the camera sits inside the scope
 - Implements PiP for some newer scopes that were lacking it (Z5 Owl Glass, CASSIAN Sharp, CASSIAN Elite) - for both VR and non-VR
 - Falls back to regular behavior for Custom Scopes that don't support PiP
---

###  Mod Options:
 - **Scope Resolution:** resolution scaling of the in-scope picture
 - **Anti-Aliasing:** use anti-aliasing (smooth out pixelated edges) for the in-scope picture
 - **Zoom Multiplier:** global multiplier of the scopes' zoom level
 - **Keep "FOV Relative Sensitivity":** makes the ''FOV Relative Sensitivity'' setting still think your FOV is zoomed in when using a scope
 - **PiP "Combat Sight":** toggle this OFF if you want a bit of realism for the ''Combat Sight'' that shouldn't have optical magnification. Works in VR too
---

### Some notes/issues:
 - Unavoidably performance-heavi**er**, primarily GPU-wise. On an RTX3060 at 1080p I get 300+ FPS with my settings - when ADS-ing with a PiP scope with the default **Scope Resolution**, I only see an increase in GPU load from 45% to 60%, and no noticeable difference in FPS. Consider lowering the **Scope resolution** in the **Mod Options** if you notice significant degradation
 - Reticles inside PiP scopes aren't affected by the breath camera shaker, making reticles fully stable, which causes a slight desync between what you see and what the gun is actually aimed at. Further investigation pending
 - ~~Some scopes on some guns may be placed too far backward, so that the PiP lens will be behind the view. Will have to either go through every single gun+scope combination in the game to make manual adjustments, or put some time into coming up with an automatic solution.~~ - pretty much resolved in v1.3
 - The zoom values of PiP scopes aren't the same as their regular zoom level - one is an FOV value, and another is a convoluted FOV multiplier
 - ~~The **FOV Relative Sensitivity** breaks~~ - fixed in v1.1
 - DOF doesn't go well with this
 - Doesn't affect the Blackmarket menu
 - [NQR](https://modworkshop.net/mod/54318) will have this built-in, later. It is incompatible with this for now
 - I don't play vanilla, so please report any unmentioned general issues if you find any

Visual Fixes & Tweaks aims to be the visual counterpart to [The Fixes](https://modworkshop.net/mod/23732). Instead of fixing Lua files, this mod focuses on correcting errors in the game's various textures, materials, and models, with some minor code edits included purely for visual purposes. There are so many fixes packed into this mod that the 20 image limit isn't even enough to showcase them all!

Because this mod aims to improve the entire game, it edits a wide variety of things. Please be cautious, as this mod may conflict with other mods that modify similar files.

**Known conflicts:**
* [No Forced Mip Values](https://modworkshop.net/mod/34949) - This mod edits a bunch of material_config files that Visual Fixes also touches, so conflicts are bound to happen. I'd recommend checking which files conflict and deleting the duplicates from either Visual Fixes or No Forced Mip Values.

* Optimized World - This mod was removed from ModWorkshop, but please be wary if you still have it installed. (I'd recommend uninstalling it regardless.)

* Mods that change map environments - A bit of a no-brainer, but just be safe!

* [Correct/Fixed Normal maps](https://modworkshop.net/mod/24922) - This mod fixes some of the same issues Visual Fixes does, and also makes a lot of normal maps more apparent by giving them actual depth rather than leaving them flat. I'd recommend handling it the same way as in the section below!

* [Stop Painting My Stuff](https://modworkshop.net/mod/36338) - Touches up weapon material_configs to stop custom colour skins from being applied to certain parts, many of which Visual Fixes also covers. Should be pretty safe to install alongside, though!

* [HD Money, Loot, & Pickups Mod](https://modworkshop.net/mod/19997) - Causes infinite loading errors due to conflicts with some jewelry material_configs. Aside from that issue, I'd actually recommend this mod!

* [Restoration Mod](https://modworkshop.net/mod/428) - Has some conflicting files with Visual Fixes, but I haven't heard of any infinite loading issues or crashes. Just be cautious.

data.name: Bullet Offset
data.desc:
Adds bullet offset so that bullets actually come from your gun instead of your face. 
Yes, the Payday gang have been spitting bullets at their enemies all this time. (They have been shot enough times to canonically do this)

**Preview gifs available under images!**
The bullet offset is dynamic with the weapon viewmodel using the fire_obj marker to position and rotate bullets. 
Forward offset is disabled, since it could cause you to shoot through walls if you are too close.

-Bullets actually follow weapon lasers!
-Height over bore is a thing now! No more pixel peeking over obstacles with high mounted optics. 
-Left side peeking is disadvantageous! Unless you've flipped your viewmodel or are dual wielding!
-Weapons shoot where they are actually pointing! Cancel-shooting an inspect animation will shoot wherever the gun is pointed.
-Shooting around corners is possible!

The bullet offset is only really noticeable for around 5-10ish meters, then bullets generally follow their normal trajectory.

Possible problem with akimbo offset: the left gun does not posses a fire_obj marker, to get around this we just flip the offset of the right gun, this might lead to problems with unsymmetrical weapon animations(vanilla ones are all symmetrical)  

I highly recommend [Tactical Leaning](https://modworkshop.net/mod/22254) by [Offyerrocker](https://modworkshop.net/user/offyerrocker) to go with this mod, as they compliment eachother quite well.

I made this because all my other  favorite shooter games have this feature and it absolutely ruined my aim without it.

Mod is at a minimal setup loading directly from main.xml instead of a mod.txt, this makes the mod a bit smaller, and also allows you to either put the mod in the mods folder or the mod_overrides folder.

**Note about WeaponLib and broken akimbo weapons**: Current WeaponLib has broken akimbo weapons. Both guns are supposed to shoot one after another once per click but with the current WeaponLib, only the right gun shoots once per click. v1.1 of my mod is compatible with this and makes the bullet spawn alternate between right and left gun. 
If you want akimbo weapons to work properly you need [Weapon Lib Akimbo one bullet fix + Improved Single/Burst Fire input](https://modworkshop.net/mod/58880) by [I AM GREEN](https://modworkshop.net/user/iamgreen) and v1.2 of my mod.
